file: The Disney Fake Book, 2nd Edition (Hal Leonard Corp).pdf
notes: Scanned (no text layer, no outline). Printed alphabetical-title index on pdf pp3-5 and by-production index pp6-9, but OCR of its page numbers was unreliable, so entries come from OCR of each page's printed title/'from Walt Disney's FILM' block (200 dpi, 227 pages); title block also found mid-page. Printed page numbers equal pdfPage (offset 0; front matter pp1-9 unnumbered). Checked by reading printed page number next to title on pp 10,12,14,15,16,18,19,20 (+ viewed p18 image). conf high only for pp<=20 which were visually verified; the rest are OCR (med). Composer credits are OCR and sometimes truncated at the scan edge (e.g. 'WASHINGT', 'CHURCI'); several composers missing. film = production printed on page. Possible tunes missed where the title block OCR failed.
